COMMITTEE OF THE WHOLE
MINUTES

A meeting of the Committee of the Whole was held on Tuesday, December 27, 2022, in Council
Chambers and via an electronic meeting, starting at 4:30 p.m. This meeting was previously
scheduled for Wednesday, December 21, 2022, at 6:00 p.m. however, was postponed due to
inclement weather. Those in attendance were as follows:

COMMITTEE MEMBERS: Scott Roybal, Chairman; Dr. Michelle Aldrich, Bryan Cook, Ken
Esquibel, Richard Johnson (via Zoom), Pete Laybourn, Tom Segrave and Jeff White. Absent: Dr.
Mark Rinne.

AGENDA ITEMS

16. ORDINANCE -2" READING ~ Amending various sections of Chapter 15.08, 15.09,
15.10, 15.12, 15.16, 15.22, 15.24 and 15.26 of Title 15, Buildings and Construction, of the
Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, updating specified building code
requirements and fees adopted by the city. (SPONSOR - MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. White moved to approve on 2! reading, seconded by Dr. Aldrich. Motion carried with
Chairman Roybal, Dr. Aldrich, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn, and Mr. White voting “YES” and
Mr. Cook, Mr. Johnson, and Mr. Segrave voting “NO”.

DISCUSSION: Antony Pomerleau, Interim Chief Building Official, provided a staff report and
Chief John Kopper, Fire & Rescue provided additional information related to the cost of
installation of fire suppression systems. Stefanie Boster, City Attomey, provided information
related to the adoption of State Statute by municipalities and Eric Fountain, Compliance Director,
provided a brief history of the adoption of related codes over the years. Committee members Dr.
Aldrich, Mr. Cook, Mr. Esquibel, Mr. Laybourn, and Mr. Segrave commented on the item.

17, ORDINANCE ~ 2" READING — Amending Section 2.84.050, International Fire Code
Board of Appeals, of Chapter 2.84, Miscellaneous Boards and Commissions, of Title 2,
Administration and Personnel, of the Municipal Code of the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming,
pertaining to the International Fire Code Board of Appeals. (SPONSOR - MR. ROYBAL)

Mr. White moved to approve on 2™ reading, seconded by Mr. Esquibel. Motion carried by
unanimous voice vote.

DISCUSSION: Chief John Kopper, Fire & Rescue, provided a staff report.

18. ORDINANCE -2" READING — Amending various sections within Chapter 8.12,
International Fire Code Adopted, of Title 8, Health and Safety, of the Municipal Code of
the City of Cheyenne, Wyoming, updating the edition of the International Fire Code
adopted by the City and further amending as specified. (SPONSOR - MR. ROYBAL)
